mapper.sql: SELECT s.id,s.station_no,s.name,s.location_text,s.status,s.created_at,s.updated_at, COALESCE(v.total_count,0) AS total_count, COALESCE(v.idle_count,0) AS idle_count, CASE WHEN s.status='enabled' THEN COALESCE(v.available_count,0) ELSE 0 END AS available_count, COALESCE(v.rented_count,0) AS rented_count, COALESCE(v.repair_count,0) AS repair_count, COALESCE(v.scrapped_count,0) AS scrapped_count FROM bike_station s LEFT JOIN ( SELECT station_id,COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status='idle' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS idle_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status='idle' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bike_rental_order o WHERE o.vehicle_id=bv.id AND o.status IN ('ongoing','exception')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bike_repair_order r WHERE r.vehicle_id=bv.id AND r.status IN ('pending','processing')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS available_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status='rented' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rented_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status='repair' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repair_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status='scrapped' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS scrapped_count FROM bike_vehicle bv GROUP BY station_id ) v ON v.station_id=s.id
